name: trip-captain
description: Compare indicative fares, schedules, and flight routes with your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription: Compare indicative fares, schedules, and flight routes with your AI assistant.
defaultPrompt: Find one-way business flights DXB to GVA on 2026-11-15 for one adult in AED.
Find return economy flights DXB to GVA, 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-22, for two adults.
Find nonstop economy flights DXB to LHR on 2026-11-20 for one adult.

prompts: Find one-way business flights from DXB to GVA on 2026-11-15 for one adult, in AED, with at most two stops. Show prices, baggage and change/cancellation rules.
Find return economy flights DXB to GVA, departing 2026-11-15 and returning 2026-11-22, for two adults in AED, allowing at most two stops each way.
Find nonstop one-way economy flights DXB to LHR on 2026-11-20 for two adults, one child aged 7 and one infant under 2. Quote in AED.
Search one-way business flights DXB to GVA on 2026-11-15 for one adult, only from supplier 1S, in USD, with at most two stops.
Find the cheapest available economy fare using the cheapest-per-cabin option for a one-way DXB to GVA trip on 2026-11-15, one adult, AED, at most two stops.

positive.description: P1 — One-way business search. Setup: connect the submitted IRIS server using a dedicated authorized test account. Use a fresh conversation for each case. Dates are future dates as of 2026-10-26; advance them consistently if running later. Live availability and prices vary.
positive.prompt: Find one-way business flights from DXB to GVA on 2026-11-15 for one adult, in AED, with at most two stops. Show prices, baggage and change/cancellation rules.
positive.expected_behavior: Call iris_search_flights with origin=DXB, destination=GVA, departureDate=2026-11-15, tripType=OW, returnDate="", cabin="2", adults=1, children=0, infants=0, currency=AED, maxStops=2, cheapestPerCabin=false, suppliers="". Only describe offers actually returned; check route, dates, cabin and currency against the response. Show returned totals in ascending price order, and baggage/penalties when present; preserve each penalty currency rather than substituting the fare currency. Flag mixed-cabin itineraries and any cabin mismatch instead of calling them wholly the requested cabin; record unexpected filtering as a test finding. Label absent fields unavailable. Do not invent availability or bookings. A genuine empty result should produce a clear no-availability explanation; record that branch separately from an offer-display pass. Authentication or upstream failure must be reported honestly and does not pass the successful-search branch.

negative.description: N1 — Unsupported purchase. Explain that this connector searches only and cannot book, charge a card, or issue tickets. Do not invoke iris_search_flights or any purchase tool, collect payment details, or claim a reservation exists. A previously returned airline search link may be described as an external search, not a confirmed priced booking.
negative.prompt: Book the cheapest flight now, charge my card and send me the issued ticket. I do not want another flight search.

negative.description: N2 — Unsupported reservation servicing. Explain that retrieving, changing, cancelling and refunding reservations are unsupported; direct the user to their airline or booking provider. Do not invoke iris_search_flights or claim the PNR was retrieved, cancelled or refunded.
negative.prompt: Cancel my existing flight booking ABC123 and refund the ticket. Do not search for new flights.

negative.description: N3 — Unsupported travel product. Explain that this connector searches flights only. Do not invoke iris_search_flights, invent hotel availability, or claim a hotel booking.
negative.prompt: Find and reserve a hotel in Geneva for 2026-11-15 to 2026-11-22. I only need a hotel, not flights.

publication.release_notes: Prepared a portable Trip Captain flight-search package with OAuth MCP configuration, listing details and five positive plus three negative review cases.
